allianceArray.name: Dev Tools
allianceArray.attraction: Powerful and Essential Tool for Android Developer.
allianceArray.desc:
This can be used to 
1. Decompile other apps
2. Layout inspector for other apps
3. View the activity history
4. Color picker like PS's eyedropper 
5. View manifest of any apps
6. Pull apk of other apps
7. Pull so of other apps
8. View info of any apps
10. More advanced features later.
